brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu's legal troubles and fight for political survival have transformed parliamentary proceedings into scenes of personal insults and acrimony, Al Jazeera English reported. The prime minister's legal jeopardy has reshaped how Israeli democracy functions, with personality politics now dominating legislative business.

The opening of parliament became a flashpoint for the tension gripping Israeli politics. Netanyahu's efforts to remain in power have overshadowed substantive legislative debate, turning parliamentary sessions into venues for personal attacks rather than policy discussion.
dek: Netanyahu's fight for political survival turns the parliament's opening into a scene of insults and acrimony.
title: Netanyahu's political survival battle turns Israeli parliament acrimonious
